methodology: Data compiled 2026-08-28 from dated listing platforms and transport sources. Rent ranges are ESTIMATES from sampled listings/guides, not quotes or guarantees; always confirm live listings. Qualitative area notes are cautious and not definitive. Commute scenarios give BTS/MRT stop counts where documented and clearly flag door-to-door times as estimates to verify in a maps app at rush hour. Scores default to null until verified. No legal/visa/tax advice. Deposit/lease terms are market practice to verify per contract.

neighbourhoods.name: On Nut

workSuitability.summary: Popular budget-friendly base for remote workers on the eastern Sukhumvit BTS line; cafes and some coworking options, with cheaper rents than central Sukhumvit. Home/reliable internet expected to be the main work base; verify venue Wi-Fi and fibre per address.

transport.airportNotes: On Nut is on the Sukhumvit BTS line (E9); no direct Airport Rail Link. BTS east toward Samrong / west into central Siam/Asok. Suvarnabhumi access is via road/taxi or BTS+ARL transfer (Phaya Thai/Makkasan) - verify door-to-door.

familySuitability.summary: Lower rents give families more space for the money, but it is a longer BTS ride to central international schools and the area is more local/mixed; family amenities and school commute need case-by-case checks.

records.notes: Entry studios/older condos; range from listings and guides.
Listings seen ~12,000-23,000 THB (The Base Sukhumvit 77 ~13.5-15k; Aspire Onnut ~19.5-23k).
2BR samples ~24,000-41,000 from a single listings source; corroborate before publishing.

housing.depositLeaseNote: Typical market practice (NOT a legal rule): long-term leases commonly ask for a 1-year contract with a 2-month security deposit + 1-month advance rent; shorter 3-6 month terms often carry a premium. Verify per contract/listing; not a quote or guarantee.

neighbourhoods.everydayConvenience: On Nut junction has a large Tesco Lotus, Century The Movie Plaza mall, street food and local markets; strong everyday convenience for the price. Verify specific building proximity.
neighbourhoods.noiseAndPace: Busy road-corridor area with Sukhumvit Road traffic; lively and local, quieter in the sois. Verify noise for a specific unit at different times.
neighbourhoods.coworkingAndConnectivity: Cafes and some coworking in/around On Nut/Phra Khanong; home fibre widely available (plans typically ~399-1,299 THB/mo per operator sources). Verify fibre at exact address and coworking day-pass rates.

commuteScenarios.walkingNote: Walk to BTS On Nut + walk from Asok to destination
commuteScenarios.transitNote: BTS westbound ~5 stops (On Nut E9 to Asok E4); rail ride roughly 15-20 min off-peak, longer at rush hour
commuteScenarios.doorToDoorNote: Estimate ~30-45 min door-to-door; CONFIRM in a maps app at 08:00

familySuitability.summary: More affordable and residential-feeling than central Sukhumvit; school/commute and family amenities unverified for this specific area.

neighbourhoods.name: Ari / Phaya Thai

workSuitability.summary: Trendy, cafe-dense low-rise neighbourhood popular with remote workers for a calmer, local feel; good BTS access and strong cafe work culture. Distinct coworking may be thinner than Sukhumvit - verify venues.

transport.airportNotes: Phaya Thai is the BTS/Airport Rail Link interchange - among the best rail-based airport access for remote workers flying often. ARL City Line runs to Suvarnabhumi.

familySuitability.summary: Calm, residential, local-community feel with parks and lower-rise living; rents are mid-to-high. School commute and family housing (2BR+) should be verified per family.

neighbourhoods.name: Central Sukhumvit (Asok / Phrom Phong / Thonglor / Ekkamai)

workSuitability.summary: The most connected, amenity-rich expat corridor: coworking, cafes, malls and business hubs; highest convenience and highest rents. Best for workers who want central networking and minimal transit.

railLines: MRT Blue Line (Sukhumvit station at Asok)
transport.airportNotes: Multiple BTS stations and MRT interchange at Asok; airport via BTS+ARL (Phaya Thai) or road.

familySuitability.summary: Excellent convenience and international amenities, but premium rents and busier nightlife pockets (esp. parts of Thonglor/Asok); families often pay for location over space. Verify school commute and unit size.

records.notes: Central Sukhumvit studio band from guides; gather dedicated listings before publish.

Premium 2BR band; weakly sourced in this study - verify on listings.

neighbourhoods.everydayConvenience: Highest in the city: BTS/MRT, malls (EmQuartier/Terminal 21), international supermarkets, hospitals, dining and coworking within minutes.

transport.airportNotes: BTS Silom line and MRT; airport via BTS+ARL (Phaya Thai) or road (longer in traffic).

familySuitability.summary: Central, well-serviced with hospitals and international schools in/around the area; premium housing. Lumphini Park nearby for families. Verify school commute and unit size.

neighbourhoods.name: Bang Na

workSuitability.summary: Far-eastern, affordable and residential: strongest for families seeking space/value (and BITEC/mega-mall amenities). Longer BTS ride to central work hubs; fewer central coworking venues - better for home-based workers.

transport.airportNotes: On the eastern Sukhumvit BTS line (Bang Na E13/Udom Suk E12/Bearing E14). Far from central Siam/Asok by rail. (An MRT monorail/Yellow Line serves the broader Bang Na-Samrong area - verify station access for a specific address.)

familySuitability.summary: Best value for space among these areas: larger condos and houses, family-oriented malls (Mega Bangna, BITEC), lower rents. Longer commute to central international schools/jobs - verify school commute carefully.

records.notes: 1BR ~9,500-22,000 (Regent Home 9.5-13k; Ideo O2 14-22k; Elio Del Nest 13-18k); typical ~14k.

Verify per contract/listing; not a quote or guarantee. Bang Na listings explicitly cite 1-year lease with 2-month security deposit + 1-month advance; common-area fees may be included.

neighbourhoods.everydayConvenience: Strong suburban convenience: Mega Bangna, BITEC, Central Bang Na, markets and local food; more car-dependent than central areas.
neighbourhoods.noiseAndPace: Quieter, residential and family-oriented; less nightlife. Sukhumvit/roads still busy.
neighbourhoods.coworkingAndConnectivity: Home fibre available; dedicated coworking thinner than central - verify venues. Home work setup is realistic.
